events.name: Jordyn Tyson
events.headline: Fantasy buzz: Does anything change in Indy with Richardson under center?

events.name: Carnell Tate
events.headline: Tate (shoulder) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Cowboys but is "considered likely" to be cleared to play, Matt Zenitz of CBS Sports reports.

events.name: Makai Lemon
events.headline: Lemon will operate as the Eagles' WR2 against the Steelers on Sunday due to the return of DeVonta Smith (hamstring).

events.name: Konata Mumpfield
events.headline: The Rams are expected to lean more on Mumpfield and the rest of the team's wide receivers in the absence of Puka Nacua (knee/toe), the latter of whom is expected to be sidelined for the remainder of the regular season, Nate Atkins and Jonathan Jones of The Athletic report.

events.name: Kyle Monangai
events.headline: Monangai (toe) doesn't have a designation for Sunday's game against the Saints.

events.name: Kenneth Walker III
events.headline: Walker (groin) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Cardinals.

events.name: Roman Wilson
events.headline: Wilson (finger) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Eagles, Brooke Pryor of ESPN.com reports.

events.name: Chris Rodriguez Jr.
events.headline: Rodriguez (hand) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Giants.
